product_wide_rationale: Answers the three predecessor strengths CD-0019 D3 left open, distributing the outcomes across workflow-engine, agent-surface, and product-memory. It closes a Product-wide mandate rather than governing any single Domain.
summary: CD-0019 D3 closes: the gated human-checkpoint lifecycle is absorbed into typed approval routes and core-derived consequence summaries; the agreement-gate discipline is preserved as the CD-0012 outcome contract enforced at completion; standalone wisdom capture is preserved as CD-0026 lesson publication into the git knowledge home. CD-0082 amends the cutover framing without changing these answers.
title: The three un-mandated predecessor strengths are answered
